definitions.gloss: leaving a group; departing from a troupe or team
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving an organized group such as a sports team, theater troupe, musical group, or similar organization.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}{限|かぎ}りで{退団|たいだん}する。
examples.english: He will leave the team at the end of this season.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{選手|せんしゅ}の{退団|たいだん}がファンに{衝撃|しょうげき}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The popular player's departure shocked the fans.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{十年間|じゅうねんかん}{在籍|ざいせき}した{劇団|げきだん}を{退団|たいだん}し、{独立|どくりつ}した。
examples.english: She left the theater troupe she had belonged to for ten years and went independent.

notes:
Most commonly used in the context of sports teams and theater troupes (especially {宝塚歌劇団|たからづかかげきだん}). The {団|だん} refers to an organized group or troupe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退団|たいだん}を{発表|はっぴょう}する — to announce one's departure
- {退団|たいだん}を{決意|けつい}する — to decide to leave the group
- {円満|えんまん}{退団|たいだん} — amicable departure
- {今季|こんき}{限|かぎ}りで{退団|たいだん} — leaving at the end of this season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脱退|だったい} — withdrawal, secession (from a larger organization, treaty, or union; stronger nuance)
- {退会|たいかい} — withdrawal from a club or association
- {退社|たいしゃ} — leaving a company
- {入団|にゅうだん} — joining a group (the opposite)
